functions.name: CODE
functions.description: Best EU Combined Nomenclature (CN/TARIC) code for a product description. Accepts a range; rows are sent in batches of 25.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Product description, or a range of descriptions. Any language.

functions.name: DESCRIPTION
functions.description: Official description of a CN/TARIC goods code.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: 10-digit goods code (8-digit CN codes accepted), or a range of codes.

functions.name: DUTY
functions.description: Import duty of a goods code: the third-country duty, or the duty listed for an origin. Advisory only.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: 10-digit goods code, or a range of codes.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: Optional. Country code such as "CN" or "US". Falls back to the third-country duty.

functions.name: VALID
functions.description: TRUE if the goods code exists in the latest EU tariff, FALSE if it is malformed or unknown.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: 10-digit goods code, or a range of codes.
